summary: The presentation details controlled experiments comparing video streaming performance with and without multi-objective quality (MOQ) feedback, demonstrating that end-to-end feedback significantly reduces storage rates and improves frame rates, especially under poor network conditions like 50% packet loss. The team proposes a new draft mechanism adding a dedicated feedback track to carry real-time delivery status and metrics, enabling dynamic switching of AI-generated video quality based on connection health.
